title: HB489 (2019 General): Concealed Carry Amendments

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Utah) (gun-policy Stage 5, Utah); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Utah text (Introduced, ; official copy, https://le.utah.gov/~2019/bills/hbillint/HB0489.pdf (Open States text id 90095414))
provenance.note: Introduced version (03-08-19); later amendments not in text read. Other edits are word changes ('person' to 'individual').

operative_text: Section 1 (Utah Code 53-5-704): (b) (i) Within 90 days before the day on which a provisional permit holder under Section 53-5-704.5 reaches 21 years old, the provisional permit holder may apply under this section for a permit to carry a concealed firearm for lawful self defense. (ii) The bureau shall issue a permit to an applicant under Subsection (1)(b)(i) within 60 days after receiving an application, unless the bureau finds proof that the applicant is not qualified to hold a permit under Subsection (2) or (3). (iii) A permit issued under this Subsection (1)(b) is not valid until an applicant reaches 21 years of age.
